w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Focus Group is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w3Mentions.firstLine: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Ad Break is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.

w5Mentions.name: The Editor
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Editor.
firstContext: "...A LEDGER," it repeats. "PROOF OF WORTH." A long, long quiet. "I HAVE NEVER BEEN WORTH ANYONE'S NOISE," it says, and the worst part is it sounds almost hopeful — asking. "WOULD YOU — IF I — " It stops itself. "NOTED. THE GRIEF STAYS WITH THE PEOPLE. ...THANK YOU FOR NOT LETTING ME STEAL IT."
Travel 3 tiles to forest floor.
Something moves out there — The Editor.
👁️ Saiful freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."

w5Mentions.name: The Timeslot
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Timeslot.
firstContext: 🕯️ Zoe is gone. The Scout — the role sits empty now, and nobody reaches for it. The Company is smaller. It keeps the name. It carries Zoe in it, the way a bell keeps ringing.
📺 Zoe died beside the party — The Company carries the name. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
Something moves out there — The Timeslot.
💬 Saiful: "Smell that? Something's different here."

You work the patch with practiced hands: 7× White Oak Acorns (in shell — shell them to eat). You also gather deadfall: 2× branches, 1× bark fiber. This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: 🌙 Raid — Ashford came in the night from the northwest. They carried off ~1000 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)

🔥 The fire settles. Peyton has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Ad Break — I put it down today." "A giant floating AD glyph with a PROGRESS BAR — the bar is the telegraph. During the pause it repositions and heals, and you watch. After the bar fills, a 'skip ad' beat appears: sk
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
📺 SYSTEM: "CONTEST: Hardened Hollow Belly. No food for three days. The System watches who breaks first. Water provided. Dignity not. The rules have changed. The audience demanded it."

w5Mentions.name: The Commercial Break
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 Scouts found the broadcast tower — tile 7,1. THE FINALE does not arrive alone: first, its crew. THE COMMERCIAL BREAK (node 1 of 3). Kill the production staff and the finale airs without a safety net — no one left to call "cut." The march needs 20 allied blades. Sound the call.
firstContext: 🪤 TRAP: Your Snare 2 tiles south caught a Gray Squirrel! — set it, waited, and the old way worked. About 350 kcal on the bone — clean it quickly (knife). It rots fast.
📻 The old ones point at the horizon and don't speak. The System, for once, is quiet too. Then: the Herald. It heralds the apocalypse the way dawn heralds the day.

🌪️ THE FINALE struck Emberhold in the night. They bled while the coalition talked. (trust −5 — they notice who wasn't there.)
— DAY 65 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.

w5Mentions.name: The Network Note
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Network Note.
firstContext: 💛 You hold Home key. The key never leaves your pocket. Locks are a promise: somewhere, a door still fits this. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they know your hands. The feast was the weapon.
Travel 1 tile to grove.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (24/13/8), with 6 wave-4 and 4 wave-5 fought, 9 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 4 · Forage 29 → 24 · capped · Craft 9 · Talk 17 · Explore 46 → 24 · capped)
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; promises kept. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Saiful Dutta ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

◈ THE PANTHEON — Peyton Michalski and Saiful Dutta ascended together, and gods, it turns out, have politics. They argue about you the way the living argue about weather. Mostly, they agree: the village comes first. Mostly.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.
It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

firenarr.line: ⚠ The store has fallen far from its recent high again — the shelves are nearly bare.

ladderLines.line: It wants the job itself: caretaking, as a practice. This is the ask the whole ladder was climbing toward.

✨ CAPSTONE: Truth Lenses. The world, unredacted. Lies show up as smudges. Hidden things show up as outlines. It was never going to drop from a monster. It was always going to be GIVEN — to someone who'd earned the shape of it.
